name: DomainInput
description: A domain ("northstar.example"), lower case; Unicode becomes punycode; a pasted URL gives its host.
signature: ({ wildcard, case: letterCase, copyable, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, icon, trailing, ...rest }: DomainInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: case
props.description: "lower" (default for domains) or "preserve" (default for host names: "NST-C106").

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only (width, grid placement). Applied to the control box.

props.name: clearable
props.description:
Show a clear button while the field has a value. Escape also clears a filled field (and
is then not propagated, so an enclosing dialog stays open); the button itself is a
pointer affordance outside the tab order.

props.name: copyable
props.description: A copy button while the value is valid (default false: names are short and visible).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. Pass the icon without a size.

props.name: identifier
props.description: Identifiers (addresses, hostnames) get tabular figures (R8.4). Default true.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid outside a Field (inside a Field, set `error` on the Field instead).

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button or Escape empties the field.

props.name: onRevealedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the show/hide password button is pressed. Pair with `revealed` to control it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the text as typed on each keystroke, and with its canonical form on blur when that
differs. Pair with `value` to control it; use `defaultValue` otherwise.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: revealed
props.description: Password boxes: whether the value shows as text. Leave unset for the box's own toggle.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint shown while the field is empty and unfocused ("mod+k" → ⌘K / Ctrl K).

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Any other trailing content (a status, a small action).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the value ("GB", "ms", "%").

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short (port, PIN), medium (name, hostname), full (default).

props.name: wildcard
props.description: Allow a leading "*." wildcard label ("*.northstar.example"). Default false.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.
